units.key: § Emuqu — Build-Time Governance of a Consumer Physiology Score > Executive Summary
units.does: Summary claims: 155 numeric constants in two files hashed with SHA-256, build fails if digest moves under the same version; stored scores carry version, old ones decode to `unversioned`; register of 19 heuristics (3 validated, 4 supported-transfer, 12 awaiting-validation) with claim/waive discovery; 64 plants; 125 targeted mutations; direction-from-filename budget ratchets. All counts verified at 8d32097 (155=91+64, hash 541b56e600080795 matches .ci baseline; register 19/3/4/12; 64 `check "` plants; 125 `mutate "` cases). The 'every stored score carries its version' claim fails for legacy sessions without a stored breakdown (see 3.1.3). The ratchet bullet now says that at this revision only integer budget files are compared, so the views-coverage floor (43.5) and a deleted budget file are not (Section 3.6.2).
